subject: Vendor portal: lightweight evidence gating and presigned upload plan
messages:
From: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@dataspring.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding to Vendr/Whistic — minimal bundle request

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the intro — were excited to get our profile into Vendr and Whistic for the upcoming procurement window. Security team asked if Redwood supports a progressive ("lightweight") evidence onboarding flow for low-risk vendors: minimal answers + a small sample bundle up front, then full evidence later in the renewal cadence.

Quick context: DataSpring is integrating Redwood into our analytics pipeline (no customer PII expected; SOC 2 scoped for infrastructure only). Our security manager is ccd and can provide the SOC 2 summary report.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm whether Vendr will accept a presigned S3 manifest + a 5-doc sample for initial review?
- Is there a templated SIG-lite / CAIQ mapping Redwood accepts for expedited intake?

Attached: screenshot of the Vendr SSO page (dataspring-sso-screenshot.png).

Thanks,
Alex Navarro
Security Ops Lead, DataSpring
security@datasec.com
(415) 555-0199

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@dataspring.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr/Whistic — minimal bundle request

Alex — thanks for the details and the screenshot. We can support a tiered intake for lower-risk integrations; below is the proposed flow weve used with a few customers successfully. Let me know if this aligns with DataSprings timeline.

Lightweight intake proposal (initial window):
1) SIG-lite mapping (consolidated answers for 30 high-value SIG questions) — well share a completed template for quick review.
2) Presigned S3 manifest + 3-5 representative evidence items (e.g., SOC 2 summary, SSO config screenshot, minimal architecture diagram). Well provide presign docs and a manifest template.
3) Temporary proof-of-possession attestation: a single line from our custodian confirming items are current and accessible.

If everything looks ok after initial review, we move to: full CAIQ completion and full evidence package within the 90-day onboarding window. For Vendr/Whistic we recommend the presigned approach to avoid portal upload friction.

Attached: presign-instructions.md (short), and a SIG-lite mapping example (sig-lite-mapping.xlsx).

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm the 3-5 items you can provide in the first 7 business days.
- Rishi: can you confirm securitys minimal acceptance criteria for SIG-lite?
- Marissa: Ill prepare the Vendr account invite and the presign bucket manifest.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Vendor Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@dataspring.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Dec 2025 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr/Whistic — minimal bundle request

Monica / Alex — quick confirmation from security: we can accept a SIG-lite + sampled evidence approach for integrations that meet these constraints:
- No production customer PII in the integration (Alex confirms this).
- SOC 2 scope limited to infrastructure or a SOC 2 summary is provided.
- Vendor provides presigned objects with a manifest; TTL on presigns must be >= 7 days to allow review.

Minimum items we expect in the sample bundle (initial review):
- SOC 2 summary (PDF)
- SSO configuration screenshot (or SCIM mapping)
- Network diagram showing boundary (PNG/PDF)
- A single sample logging/syslog snapshot (redacted) or description of retention policy

Well accept SIG-lite answers for the high-risk questions (Ive flagged 12 that require fully-complete answers). We can live with abbreviated answers on low-risk controls as long as the sample evidence covers them. After the initial acceptance well schedule the full CAIQ completion within 60 days.

Security note: please ensure the presigned link flow is to our review bucket (we will give S3 presign policies) and that you do not email sensitive attachments unencrypted.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Security
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@dataspring.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Dec 2025 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr/Whistic — minimal bundle request

Alex — great, thanks for confirming scope. To make this painless heres the upload plan and a short checklist: please use the presigned manifest weve attached and include the three required sample files below. Well do the initial review within 5 business days of receipt.

Checklist (initial upload):
- presign-manifest.json (format example in presign-instructions.md)
- SOC 2 summary (pdf): DataSpring SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted ok)
- SSO screenshot (png): as attached earlier
- Network boundary diagram (pdf/png)

Presign notes:
- Upload TTL: 14 days preferred (min 7)
- Put files under /dataspring/initial-review/ in the presign manifest
- Include a single line attestation in README.txt: "I certify these artifacts are current as of yyyy-mm-dd" and signer name/title

Well also create a Whistic profile draft so security reviewers can comment inline. Expect an invite from Vendr within 24 hours; Marissa will coordinate the vendor-facing steps.

Marissa, please create the Vendr invite and add the initial checklist into the ticketing flow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Monica Patel
Vendor Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: dataspring-sso-screenshot.png; sig-lite-mapping.xlsx; presign-instructions.md
